title: Ambassador walkthrough: progressive deployment checkpoint playbooks
creator: Mia Patel
description:
Design a lightweight, contextual in-product walkthrough (the 'Ambassador') that appears the first time an engineer creates a rollout or dedicated deployment. The Ambassador surfaces a 3-step progressive checklist tied to deployment checkpoints (configure model & variant, set capacity & autoscale, review cost and SLA), includes inline microcopy explaining cost tradeoffs, and provides two quick actions: 'Try in sandbox' and 'Apply minimal cost profile'. The experience should be skimmable, dismissible, and resumable from Console > Rollouts. Goals: reduce first-time rollback rate, increase users completing safe default rollouts, and surface cost literacy without blocking task completion.

Scope:
- Three-step micro-walkthrough anchored to the Rollout creation flow (modal + in-page pill state).
- Empty-state templates for teams that haven't created rollouts yet: includes seed templates (canary, blue-green, low-cost starter) with estimated token/cost callouts.
- Tooltips and microcopy explaining batching, dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs, and cost levers (batch size, quantization profiles).
- Persistent 'Ambassador' transcript accessible from the rollout detail page so users can resume later.
- A11y: keyboard navigable, screen reader friendly labels, color contrast compliant.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype demonstrates the 3-step flow integrated into the existing Rollouts UI (Figma + clickable prototype).
- Copy for all steps reviewed by PM and Engineering and validated against cost estimation copy guardrails.
- Two seed templates created with backend stubs for estimated cost shown (mocked values OK for now).
- UX passes 3 heuristic reviews: discoverability, interruption budget, and resumability.
- Handoff-ready component spec including microcopy tokens, spacing, and state diagrams.

Design notes & constraints:
- Avoid modal-heavy patterns that block progress; prefer in-flow stepper anchored to top-right of the creation panel.
- Cost nudges must be informational, not blocking; include 'Why this matters' micro expandable panel linked to docs.
- Keep initial Ambassador lightweight (target max 3 cards) to reduce cognitive load for first-time users.
- Defer integrating actual cost APIs to a follow-up ticket; wireframe should support dynamic estimates later.

Success metrics (baseline & targets):
- Completion rate of first rollout: baseline 46% -> target 62% within 30 days of exposure.
- Time-to-first-safe-rollout (median): reduce by 25%.
- Click-through to cost explainer docs from Ambassador: >20% of exposed users.

Dependencies:
- ENG-342890 (rollout API: expose templating hooks)
- PM-88012 (pricing copy & guardrails signoff)
- ENG-357401 (sandbox provisioning endpoint for 'Try in sandbox' action)

Deliverables:
- High-fidelity Figma screens + clickable prototype (happy path, dismiss & resume).
- Microcopy file with variants for short, medium, and long tooltip lengths.
- Front-end component spec and CSS tokens for stepper and pill states.
- Design review notes and accessibility checklist.
